lper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local EffectHelper=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("EffectHelper"))
local RangedCombatClient=require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("RangedCombatClient"))
local LocalPlayer=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local featureSwitch=game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版移动端射击视角")
local tool=script.Parent
local isFire=tool:WaitForChild("Values"):WaitForChild("IsFire")
local TryFire=tool:WaitForChild("TryFire")
local FireS2C=tool:WaitForChild("FireS2C")
local Main=tool:WaitForChild("Main")
local Bolt=tool:WaitForChild("Bolt")
local BoltBack=tool:WaitForChild("BoltBack")
local FlashFX=Main:WaitForChild("FlashFX")
local FX=Main:WaitForChild("FX")
local FireSound=Main:WaitForChild("FireSound")
local idleTrack
local fireTrack
local active=false
local holding=false
local boltIndex=1
local fireCount=tool:WaitForChild("配置"):WaitForChild("发射数量").Value
local fireSerial=0

local function sampleAndInvoke(context,token,burstIndex)
	local aim
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then aim=RangedCombatClient.SampleAim(context) end
	local endPos=aim and aim.AimWorldPosition or GameHelper:GetMouseWorldPosition()
	local origin=Main.Position
	local delta=endPos-origin
	if delta.Magnitude<=0.001 then return false end
	local params=RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params:AddToFilter(LocalPlayer.Character)
	params:AddToFilter(game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Fog))
	local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,delta.Unit*100,params)
	return TryFire:InvokeServer(result and result.Instance or nil,result and result.Position or origin+delta.Unit*100,token,burstIndex)
end
local function beginFire(context)
	if not active or holding or isFire.Value or tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	holding=true
	fireSerial+=1
	local serial=fireSerial
	local shotContext
	if RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then shotContext=RangedCombatClient.BeginShot(context) if not shotContext then holding=false return end end
	if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then
		sampleAndInvoke(context,nil,nil)
		holding=false
		return
	end
	task.spawn(function()
		for burstIndex=1,fireCount do
			if not active or not holding or serial~=fireSerial or tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character then break end
			local accepted=sampleAndInvoke(context,shotContext.ShotToken,burstIndex)
			if accepted~=true then break end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		if serial==fireSerial then holding=false end
	end)
end
local function endFire()
	holding=false
	fireSerial+=1
end
local function cancelFire()
	holding=false
	fireSerial+=1
end
local function bindNewInput()
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindFireActions(tool)
	if active and RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then RangedCombatClient.BindFireActions(tool,beginFire,endFire) end
end
local function onIsFireChanged()
	if fireTrack then if isFire.Value then fireTrack:Play() else fireTrack:Stop() end end
	FX.Enabled=isFire.Value
	if isFire.Value then
		while isFire.Value do
			boltIndex=1-boltIndex
			FlashFX.Enabled=boltIndex==1
			Bolt.Transparency=boltIndex==1 and 1 or 0
			BoltBack.Transparency=boltIndex==0 and 1 or 0
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	else FlashFX.Enabled=false end
end
task.defer(onIsFireChanged)
tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
	if tool.Parent~=LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	active=true
	idleTrack=CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(LocalPlayer.Character,112057956553263) idleTrack.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2 idleTrack.Looped=true idleTrack:Play()
	fireTrack=CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(LocalPlayer.Character,81288906960141) fireTrack.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3 fireTrack.Looped=true
	RangedCombatClient.BindWeaponCrosshair(tool)
	bindNewInput()
end)
tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	active=false cancelFire()
	RangedCombatClient.UnbindWeaponCrosshair(tool)
	if idleTrack then idleTrack:Stop() idleTrack:Destroy() idleTrack=nil end
	if fireTrack then fireTrack:Stop() fireTrack:Destroy() fireTrack=nil end
end)
tool.Activated:Connect(function() if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then beginFire(nil) end end)
featureSwitch.Changed:Connect(function() if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then endFire() end bindNewInput() end)
UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredInput"):Connect(function() if not RangedCombatClient.IsEnabled() then endFire() end bindNewInput() end)
isFire.Changed:Connect(onIsFireChanged)
FireS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(hit,endPos)
	if not isFire.Value then return end
	local hitCharacter=false
	if hit and GameHelper:IsNPC(hit) then hitCharacter=true end
	local cframe=Main.CFrame
	local bullet=workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("Bullet"):Clone()
	bullet.Anchored=true bullet.Parent=workspace bullet.CFrame=cframe
	FireSound:Play()
	local distance=(cframe.Position-endPos).Magnitude
	local info=TweenInfo.new(distance/500,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,0.1)
	game.TweenService:Create(bullet,info,{CFrame=cframe.Rotation+endPos}):Play()
	EffectHelper:AddItem(bullet,info.Time,true)
	if not hitCharacter then
		local effect=EffectHelper:CreateWorkspaceEffect("BulletHit")
		effect.Position=endPos effect.Parent=workspace
		CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(effect,true)
		EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,0.15)
	end
end)

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local AudioHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("AudioHelper"))
local UIHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))
local InteractiveHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("InteractiveHelper"))
local ToolHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ToolHelper"))
local MeleeCombatClient = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("MeleeCombatClient"))
local MeleeWeaponSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("MeleeWeaponSetting"))
local newMeleeSwitch = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("玩法开关"):WaitForChild("新版近战判定")

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local tool = script.Parent
local sound = script.Parent:WaitForChild("Blade"):WaitForChild("Swing")
local BlockBtn = script:WaitForChild("BlockBtn")
local BlockBtn2 = script:WaitForChild("BlockBtn2")
local BlockEnergy = script:WaitForChild("BlockEnergy")
local BlockAction = script:WaitForChild("BlockAction")
local AttackRange = script:WaitForChild("AttackRange").Value
local rangeValue: NumberValue = tool:FindFirstChild("Range")
-- The synchronized prefab Range avoids a cold resource-config lookup when
-- the lightsaber is first loaded. AttackRange remains the final fallback.
local meleeProfile = if rangeValue then nil else MeleeWeaponSetting.GetByTool(tool)
if rangeValue then
	AttackRange = rangeValue.Value
elseif meleeProfile and meleeProfile.reach then
	AttackRange = meleeProfile.reach
end
local SetBlockC2S = tool:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("SetBlockC2S")
local v_IsBlock = tool:WaitForChild("Values"):WaitForChild("IsBlock")
local v_Energy = tool:WaitForChild("Values"):WaitForChild("Energy")
local energyMax = tool:WaitForChild("Values"):WaitForChild("EnergyMax").Value

local character:Model = nil
local blockIdleTrack:AnimationTrack
local blockTracks:{AnimationTrack} = {}
local blockTrackIndex = 0
local atkTracks:{AnimationTrack} = {}
local atkTrackIndex = 0

local hitSounds = {"近战武器Hit1","近战武器Hit2"}

math.randomseed(tick())

local function onLastInputTypeChanged()
	if character ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	
	local isgamepad = InteractiveHelper.isGamepad
	BlockBtn.img_icon.Visible = not isgamepad
	BlockBtn.img_gamepadIcon.Visible = isgamepad
end

tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
	character = tool.Parent
	if character ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	onLastInputTypeChanged()
	BlockBtn.Parent = UIHelper:GetRootGUI("UIInterface","UIInteractive")
	BlockBtn2.Parent = UIHelper:GetRootGUI("UIInterface","UIInteractiveMobile")
	BlockEnergy.Parent = UIHelper:GetRootGUI("UIInterface","UILeftFrame")
	local anims = {
		script:WaitForChild("Overhead"),
		script:WaitForChild("Swing"),
		script:WaitForChild("Thrust")
	}
	for _,anim:Animation in ipairs(anims) do
		local atkTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character,anim)
		if atkTrack then
			atkTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
			atkTrack.Looped = false
			table.insert(atkTracks,atkTrack)
		end
	end
	
	local anims = {
		script:WaitForChild("Block1Anim"),
		script:WaitForChild("Block2Anim"),
	}
	for _,anim:Animation in ipairs(anims) do
		local blockTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character,anim)
		if blockTrack then
			blockTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3
			blockTrack.Looped = false
			table.insert(blockTracks,blockTrack)
		end
	end
	
	if not blockIdleTrack then
		blockIdleTrack = CommonFunc:LoadAnimation(character,script:WaitForChild("BlockIdleAnim"))
		blockIdleTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
		blockIdleTrack.Looped = true
	end
	
	local refreshEnergyGUI = function()
		local size = BlockEnergy.Slide.Size
		BlockEnergy.Slide.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(v_Energy.Value / energyMax,0,1),size.Y.Scale)
	end
	
	local lastEnergy = -1
	while tool.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character do
		if lastEnergy ~= v_Energy.Value then
			lastEnergy = v_Energy.Value
			refreshEnergyGUI()
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)

tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
	if character ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	BlockBtn.Parent = script
	BlockBtn2.Parent = script
	BlockEnergy.Parent = script
	BlockAction:Fire(false)
	
	-- 停止所有动画
	for _,track:AnimationTrack in ipairs(atkTracks) do
		track:Stop()
		track:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(atkTracks)
	for _,track:AnimationTrack in ipairs(blockTracks) do
		track:Stop()
		track:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(blockTracks)
	
	blockIdleTrack:Stop()
	blockIdleTrack:Destroy()
	blockIdleTrack = nil
	--print(BlockAction:GetState())	
	character = nil
end)

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	if character ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	--if v_IsBlock.Value then return end

	atkTrackIndex += 1
	if atkTrackIndex > #atkTracks then atkTrackIndex = 1 end
	local track = atkTracks[atkTrackIndex]
	if track then track:Play() end
	sound:Play()

	tool.Enabled = false
	task.delay(0.5,function()
		if tool.Parent == character then
			tool.Enabled = true
		end
	end)

	if newMeleeSwitch.Value then
		MeleeCombatClient.BeginSwing(tool, character)
	else
		task.wait(0.2)
		if newMeleeSwitch.Value then return end
		if GameHelper:TryPlayerMeleeAttack(character, AttackRange) then
			local soundName = hitSounds[math.random(1, #hitSounds)]
			AudioHelper:PlayEffect(soundName, tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"))
		end
	end
end)

v_IsBlock.Changed:Connect(function(value: boolean) 
	if character ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	if v_IsBlock.Value then
		blockIdleTrack:Play()
	else
		blockIdleTrack:Stop()
	end	
end)

InteractiveHelper.onLastInputTypeChanged.Event:Connect(onLastInputTypeChanged)

BlockAction.StateChanged:Connect(function(value) 
	if character ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	if v_Energy.Value < energyMax then return end
	
	local isBlock = BlockAction:GetState()
	if not v_IsBlock.Value and isBlock then
		SetBlockC2S:FireServer(isBlock)
	end
end)

GameHelper.BlockBulletS2C.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(whoCharacterTrigger:Model) 
	if character ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	if whoCharacterTrigger ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	
	blockTrackIndex += 1
	if blockTrackIndex > #blockTracks then blockTrackIndex = 1 end
	local track = blockTracks[blockTrackIndex]
	track:Play()
	track:AdjustSpeed(2)
	task.wait(0.2)
	track:Stop()
end)"},{"id":86,"text":"local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local tool = script.Parent
local handler = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local highlight = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild("Highlights"):WaitForChild("CraftHighlight")
local Sound = handler:WaitForChild("Sound")

local selectCraft:Model = nil

tool.Equipped:Connect(function(mouse: Mouse) 
	if tool.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then return end
	
	local con = tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		if selectCraft then
			Sound:Play()
			tool.dismantle:FireServer(selectCraft)
		end
	end)
	
	while tool.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character do
		local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
		overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Craft)
		overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

		local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(handler.Position,5,overlapParams)

		local closetCraft:Model
		local closetDistance = 99999
		local checkCraft:{Model} = {}
		for _,hit in ipairs(hits) do
			local craft:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(hit,GameEnum.Tag.Craft)

			if craft then
				if table.find(checkCraft,craft) then continue end
				table.insert(checkCraft,craft)
				local distance = (craft:GetPivot().Position - handler.Position).Magnitude
				if distance < closetDistance then
					closetCraft = craft
					closetDistance = distance
				end
			end
		end

		selectCraft = closetCraft
		highlight.FillColor = Color3.new(0,1,0)
		highlight.Adornee = closetCraft
		highlight.Enabled = closetCraft ~= nil

		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	
	selectCraft = nil
	con:Disconnect()
	highlight.Adornee = nil
	highlight.Enabled = false
end)"},{"id":87,"text":"local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

	local id = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(craft,CraftValue.id)

	end
end)

local Tool = script.Parent
local velocity = Tool.Config:FindFirstChild("投掷力度").Value

local ThrowC2S = Tool.ThrowC2S

local AttackAble = true
local rand = 11.25

math.randomseed(tick())

function getPlayer()
	local char = Tool.Parent
	return game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
end

function Toss(startPosition:Vector3,direction:Vector3,force:number)
	force = math.clamp(force,velocity * 0.1,velocity)
	local Object = Tool.Handle:Clone()
	Object:PivotTo(CFrame.new(startPosition))
	Object.Transparency = 0
	Object.CanCollide = true
	Object.CanTouch = false

-- Play the animation track

local SandController = script.Parent:WaitForChild('Model'):WaitForChild('SandController')

local minDig = 0.2 --挖一次最小值
local maxDig = 0.3 --挖一次最大值 QTE用

local maxPan = 1 --填满需要

--可挖出来的道具

	{id = 701, weight = 25}, --蓝
	{id = 702, weight = 25}, --红
	{id = 703, weight = 25}, --黄
	{id = 704, weight = 10}, --绿
	{id = 705, weight = 28}, --水晶
	{id = 210, weight = 12}, --
	{id = 211, weight = 12}, --
	{id = 222, weight = 1}, --
	{id = 223, weight = 1}, --
}

--local origincFrame = sand.CFrame

local digNum = 0

function digSand()

	--TODO不同的地方挖的土颜色会不同，还可以洗出不同的矿石，特殊土壤有特殊道具，但是现在就先这样，也许该用 
	sand.Transparency = 0
	
	digNum = digNum + minDig*10
	SandController:SetAttribute('Alpha',digNum/10)
	--print(SandController:GetAttribute('Alpha'))
	pan:WaitForChild('BillboardGui'):WaitForChild('t_num').Text = digNum..'/'..(maxPan*10)
	script:WaitForChild('DigSound'):Play()
	
	if SandController:GetAttribute('Alpha') >= maxPan then
		
		canBewash = true
		pan:WaitForChild('BillboardGui'):WaitForChild('t_num').TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
		--定好奖励
		local randomNum = math.random(1,3) --随机数量

		for i = 1, randomNum do
			local arr = pan:WaitForChild('Point'):GetChildren()
			
			local gemInfo = CommonFunc:WeightedRandomV1(digObjectArr1) --
			table.insert(gemArr,gemInfo.id)
			
			local gem = gemPack:WaitForChild(tostring(gemInfo.id)):Clone() --随机宝石
			gem.Parent = pan:WaitForChild('Gem')
			gem:ScaleTo(math.random(1,2))
			gem:PivotTo(arr[i].CFrame) --设置位置 --gem.PrimaryPart.Size.Y/3
			--将宝石和盘焊接
			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part1 = arr[i]
			weld.Parent = pan
			weld.Part0 = gem.PrimaryPart
			gem.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
		end

	end
	
end

		if not kickAnimationTrack1.IsPlaying then

				--洗一半的时候石头发光
				for k,v in ipairs(pan:WaitForChild('Gem'):GetChildren()) do
					v.PrimaryPart.Transparency = 0
					v.PrimaryPart:WaitForChild('Glow').Enabled = true
					v.PrimaryPart:WaitForChild('Sparkles').Enabled = true
				end
			end
			
			if SandController:GetAttribute('Alpha') == 0 then
				--清完沙，发送奖励
				sand.Transparency = 1
				canBewash = false
				
				wait(2)
				--TODO:奖励直接蹦出来

					v:Destroy()
				end
				
			end
			

		else
			
			if not canBewash then
				UIHelper:PopCenterTips("Fill your gold pan with sand and mud",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
			elseif not character:HasTag('OnWater') then
				UIHelper:PopCenterTips("Put the gold pan into the water",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
			end
			
		end

	end

end)

	end
